name: Neighborly Balcony
text: After scoring, if your team made its contract, you and your partner each gain +20 gold.

signature.trigger: after scoring, when your team made its contract

decision: None in play; it rewards steady contracts and grows both collections.
rationale: About +16 gold a round for you at an 80% make rate, and as much again for your partner, whose purchases also help your team.
deviation: Revision 1: replaced swapping sigils with your partner after bidding, which was fiddly and rarely worth it.
